title: Joseph McMoneagle awarded the Legion of Merit for remote viewing

tellings.quote: you have guys like Joseph mcmonagle who have won the Legion of Merit for over 200 instances

plain: An Army remote viewer named Joseph McMoneagle is said to have won the Legion of Merit, a US military decoration, for more than 200 instances of remote viewing, meaning the claimed ability to describe distant places or events by the mind alone. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, as a sign that the military took remote viewing seriously enough to reward it.
